mapper.select: SELECT PA.ID AS p_application_id , PAR.ID AS par_id , S.ID AS s_id , SI.NICKNAME AS nickname , (SELECT NVL(AVG(SE.SCORE), 0) FROM SEEKER_EVALUATION SE WHERE S.ID = SE.S_ID) AS score FROM SEEKER S, SEEKER_INFO SI, POSTING_APPLICATION PA, POSTING_APP_RESPONSE PAR WHERE S.ID = SI.S_ID AND S.ID = PA.S_ID AND PA.ID = PAR.P_APPLICATION_ID AND S.ID = #{s_id}
